headline: Saudi Arabia shuts down the East-West energy pipeline – New pressure on markets due to the Houthis
summary: Saudi Arabia has preventively suspended operations of the East-West pipeline following an attack. The decision adds pressure on the global oil market.
why: The East-West pipeline lets Saudi Arabia export crude from the Gulf coast to the Red Sea, bypassing the Strait of Hormuz.
why_moved: Suspension of a key export pipeline following an attack removes a route for Saudi crude, tightening global supply expectations.
